title: Audio playback not audible
problem_statement: User reports that game sounds are not audible.
game_flow_context: feedback / SFX / BGM / input gesture / browser audio lifecycle
validated_decisions: Treat audio as feedback clarity, not as a gameplay rule redesign.
Do not reopen wave, arena, scoring, enemy, player, bullet, or onion behavior.
Next step is technical impact analysis before any build.
validated_facts: index.html declares audio tags for bgm, gameover-sfx, shot-sfx, bounce-sfx, onion-death-sfx, and levelup-sfx.
Referenced audio asset files exist under sounds/ and are non-empty.
js/ui/audio.js owns the audio controller for BGM/SFX playback.
main.js wires DOM audio elements into createAudioController.
README.md states that WebAudio/BGM starts only after a user gesture.
js/loader.js versions audio URLs through existing asset versioning.
draft_assumptions_in_play: The report refers to the current browser game runtime.
The likely fix is in existing audio wiring, asset/versioning, user gesture handling, or lifecycle behavior.
New audio assets are not needed unless investigation proves an existing referenced file is invalid.
Browser manual validation is required because audibility cannot be proven with static checks alone.
current_direction: Route to gameplay-programmer for implementation spec and file impact map.
Require browser audio manual tests for any build.
explicit_non_goals: No replacement soundtrack or SFX redesign.
No gameplay rule, wave, arena, scoring, enemy, player, bullet, or onion behavior changes.
No HUD/audio settings panel unless a minimal browser-unlock affordance is proven necessary.
No broad loader or app lifecycle rewrite.
backward_compatibility_concerns: Browser autoplay policy may require user gesture before BGM/SFX playback.
Changing loader asset versioning can affect all cached assets if done broadly.
Changing lifecycle resume behavior can restart audio unexpectedly after overlays or tab visibility changes.
Logging rejected play promises can aid diagnosis but must not spam normal gameplay.
required_validations: node --input-type=module --check < changed-js-file> for each changed JS file.
Browser load with console and network check for audio asset requests.
Manual browser audio checklist covering BGM, shot, bounce, onion death, game over, level-up, and pause/resume.
human_test_checklist: Start the game through the normal Play/user gesture path and confirm BGM becomes audible or a clear unlock path exists.
Fire a shot and confirm shot SFX is audible.
Bounce a bullet and confirm bounce SFX is audible.
Kill an onion and confirm onion death SFX is audible.
Trigger game over and confirm game-over SFX is audible while BGM behavior remains coherent.
Trigger level transition and confirm level-up SFX is audible and fade behavior remains coherent.
Pause/background and resume the tab and confirm audio does not remain permanently muted.
Hard refresh after asset versioning and confirm no stale missing audio URL remains.
open_questions: Are audio requests succeeding in the browser network panel?
Does the browser reject play() with NotAllowedError, AbortError, unsupported media, missing asset, or another reason?
Does audio fail for all sounds or only BGM/SFX?
Does the issue reproduce only before the first user gesture, after game over/continue, or after tab visibility changes?
decision_log_summary: LOG-001: task-orchestrator opened audio bug thread and routed to gameplay-programmer for technical impact analysis.
